# Jnanaranjan Sahoo — Full-Stack & AI Engineer

Odisha, India · English · Hindi · Odia · sahoojnana3002@gmail.com

## About

I'm Jnana, a full-stack and AI engineer from Odisha, India. I work across the stack, from databases and backends to frontends and deployment, and on the AI systems in between: LLM apps, retrieval, voice agents and computer vision.

I spent a year at Skillablers in Bangalore shipping production AI systems: a real-time voice agent, a self-hosted question-answering assistant and computer-vision features. I'm also building Swaram, a voice AI platform for small Indian businesses, as my own product. I'm AWS Certified as a Cloud Practitioner and an AI Practitioner.

- 2×: AWS Certified
- 4+: Systems in production
- <1 s: Voice AI latency
- AWS: Certified Cloud Practitioner
- AWS: Certified AI Practitioner
- B.Tech: Computer Science · 2024

## Experience

### Software Engineer — Skillablers Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Jun 2025 — May 2026 · 1 year · Bangalore

- Built a real-time conversational voice agent for automated surveys that replies in under a second (LiveKit, Sarvam, Gemini).
- Built and deployed an on-premise question-answering assistant for a cultural institution: self-hosted LLMs, no external API calls, cached answers in under 2 seconds.
- Set up self-hosted AI infrastructure (Ollama behind a LiteLLM gateway; text-to-speech in several Indian languages, including Odia) and a document-digitisation pipeline with a fine-tuned layout-detection model.
- Built face verification, image-similarity and proctoring features for a hiring-assessment app (Flutter, TFLite, YOLO, EfficientNet).

## Projects

### Swaram — voice AI for small businesses

A multi-tenant SaaS that answers business phone calls in Indian languages. I'm building it end to end: FastAPI backend, Next.js dashboard, SIP telephony, background jobs, usage billing and RAG over each business's own data. Pitched at the BuildAI Tech Pitch Sprint, IIT Gandhinagar (2026).

- Status: In development · own product
- Tech: FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL + pgvector, LiveKit, Redis, Razorpay
- Link: https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects

### Drishti — on-premise video analytics

Plugs into existing CCTV cameras and runs detection on one low-cost edge device, so footage never leaves the site. Designed for warehouses, factories and retail.

- Status: Proof of concept · own product
- Tech: Python, Computer vision, YOLO, Edge AI, Docker
- Link: https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects

### Data analysis agent

Upload a dataset and ask questions in plain English. A LangGraph agent profiles the data, writes and runs pandas code in an isolated sandbox, and streams back charts and answers.

- Status: Personal project
- Tech: LangGraph, Gemini, FastAPI, E2B sandbox, Docker
- Link: https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects
